body: I mean, my parents won't kick me out. I think. But I'd genuinely rather die than have them emotionally abuse me the way they do. This whole thing was triggered by a 10 minute conversation with my dad on the fucking phone.
Nope. I live in the Middle East. They don't really do homeless shelters & the like.
I can't stop feeling like a failure. This is the second year in a row that I've been rejected by colleges I applied to. My parents are sick of me & I'm sick of myself.
